entry.name: Test workflow runs on all four runners
entry.expected: After pushing mallow and opening the pull request, test.yml starts four jobs (ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-15-intel, macos-15) for both the push and the pull_request event. In each job 'Check the shell-test tools' runs before 'Test', and all four jobs pass. A timing-budget failure on a hosted runner goes to the owner with the test name and its measured number (D-04), with no loosened budget and no --release.
entry.why_human: Out-of-reach resource. The workflow runs only on GitHub's hosted runners, this verifier may not touch the network, and it has never run there. The static content and the local tool-check script were verified. What the macOS and arm images actually carry, and whether the debug-build hook meets its p99 budget there, can only be seen in a real run.
